name: Icon Browser
description: Developer tool for mod authors: a full-screen in-game browser for Darktide's UI icon materials. Search, filter and sort the indexed icons, inspect a large preview with the full material path and where the game uses it, find related icons, and copy paths, filenames, Lua strings, Lua tables or ready-to-use UI snippets for your own mods. Not a gameplay mod.
author: LucLeto
